newsitem.title: SAUDI ARABIA: Saudi beheads five Nigerians for armed robbery.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads five Nigerians for armed robbery.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Sunday beheaded five Nigerians for armed robbery, Saudi state-run television said.
An Interior Ministry statement carried on the television said the five were executed in Mecca after being found guilty of opening fire on people and using hatchets in robberies.
The beheadings raised to 11 the number of people executed in the conservative Islamic kingdom so far this year.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
